subject: E-Commerce
title: Depop: Gen Z Thrift Culture
description: A quick, practical guide to Depop: Gen Z Thrift Culture.

hook.text: Depop has 30 million users and 90% are under 26. It blends social media with secondhand fashion in one app.

buildup.text: Depop feels like Instagram for clothes. Sellers curate aesthetic profiles, style outfits, and build personal brands.

discovery.text: Sustainability drives Depop's growth. Gen Z prefers secondhand because it's cheaper AND better for the environment.

twist.text: Some Depop sellers buy fast fashion from Shein and resell it as 'vintage.' The sustainability narrative gets exploited.

climax.text: Depop captured Gen Z by combining values, aesthetics, and commerce. The social layer is what makes it a marketplace.

punchline.text: 30 million users, 90% under 26. Depop made thrift shopping social, aesthetic.

quiz.question: Why does Depop appeal strongly to Gen Z?
options: It combines social media aesthetics with sustainable secondhand fashion
